title: Clearer prediction feedback
changes: Correct and retry answers appear in structured feedback cards with distinct icons.
Submitted numeric answers show load divided by mechanical advantage and rounded effort.
Blank answers and young learners choice answers omit the calculation.
Editing a numeric answer clears stale feedback without removing earned station progress.

validation.notes: The initial light screenshot run timed out on a locator whose heading gained the proven badge. The locator was corrected; the final light run passed.

publication: Local only; no commit, push, or deployment
